about: HD Fire Protect Limited is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of fire protection equipment and systems, offering solutions across water, foam, and gas-based suppression technologies. The company operates two vertically integrated manufacturing facilities in Jalgaon and Thane, Maharashtra, spanning 8.50 acres. It serves residential, commercial, and heavy industrial applications, exporting to over 90 countries worldwide.

objects.purpose: Offer for Sale by Promoter Selling Shareholders

promoters.background: Harish Narshi Dharamshi brings over 41 years of experience in the fire protection industry. Other promoters Miheer Ghotikar, Anik Dharamshi, and Parika Ghotikar each have over 16 years of experience.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 23.69% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026. Top 10 suppliers contributed 47.76% of total expenses in Fiscal 2026.

litigation_note: The company and its directors are involved in certain outstanding legal proceedings, and compounding and adjudication applications are pending for past Companies Act non-compliances.
strengths: Second-largest fire protection equipment manufacturer in India by operating revenue and largest exporter by value in Fiscal 2025.
Comprehensive portfolio across eight categories covering water, foam, and gas-based suppression systems.
Holds the highest number of UL Listed and FM Approved product certifications among fire protection peers in India.
Established global distribution network spanning over 90 export countries with 34.69% export revenue in Fiscal 2026.
High customer stickiness with repeat customers accounting for 85.20% of Fiscal 2026 revenue.
Vertically integrated manufacturing facilities in Jalgaon and Thane with in-house design, casting, machining, and testing.
Robust financial profile with 14.54% revenue CAGR (FY24-26) and 30.75% Operating EBITDA margin in Fiscal 2026.
Experienced promoter-led management team with over four decades of industry expertise.

risks.title: Equipment Failure Liability
risks.detail: Malfunction of life-safety fire protection equipment can lead to loss of life, extensive property damage, warranty invocations, and severe legal liabilities.

risks.title: Supplier Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers accounted for 47.76% of total expenses in Fiscal 2026, without any long-term supply contracts or firm commitments.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration of Manufacturing
risks.detail: Manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra accounted for 63.49% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026, creating operational shutdown risks.

risks.title: Customer Contract Structure
risks.detail: Repeat customers contributed 85.20% of FY26 revenue, but sales rely on short-term purchase orders without long-term commitments or exclusivity.

risks.title: International Market Risk
risks.detail: Export revenues represented 34.69% of revenue from operations in FY26, exposing business to geopolitical and economic changes in key markets.

risks.title: Import and Raw Material Dependence
risks.detail: Imports constituted approximately 45% of total procurement in Q1 FY27, making operations vulnerable to shipping disruptions and price volatility.

risks.title: Legal and Regulatory Proceedings
risks.detail: The company faces outstanding litigation and pending regulatory compounding and adjudication applications for past Companies Act non-compliances.

risks.title: Pure Offer for Sale
risks.detail: The entire issue of ₹712.13 crore consists of an Offer for Sale with no proceeds received by the company.

notes: Financial figures are restated standalone for Fiscals 2024, 2025, and 2026. Stub period for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (Revenue ₹109.05 cr, PAT ₹23.87 cr, Order Book ₹158.60 cr) has been ignored in the financial arrays.
